description: PCA-128-conditioned orthogonal corrective mesh decoder for the QC-controlled ADNI left hippocampus correspondence meshes.

scientific_contract.model_input: PCA coefficients only; no target mesh or target residual is provided to the decoder
scientific_contract.latent_contract: all 128 PCA coefficients are retained; no learned latent dimensions are added
scientific_contract.correction_contract: predicted displacement is hard-projected outside the retained PCA subspace
scientific_contract.selection: lowest validation per-coordinate RMSE in millimetres, with exact PCA at epoch zero
scientific_contract.test_policy: test evaluation requires an explicit --allow-test flag
scientific_contract.runtime_outputs: all checkpoints, logs, reports, and generated meshes must be below /mnt/bulk10tb
